definitions.explanation: The act of resisting or opposing authority, rules, or established norms.

examples.japanese: {親|おや}に{反抗|はんこう}する{時期|じき}がある。
examples.english: There's a period of rebelling against parents.

examples.japanese: {不当|ふとう}な{命令|めいれい}に{反抗|はんこう}した。
{反抗|はんこう}{期|き}の{子供|こども}は{扱|あつか}いが{難|むずか}しい。
examples.english: Children in their rebellious phase are difficult to handle.

notes:
USAGE: {反抗|はんこう} refers to opposing or resisting authority. It's commonly used when discussing adolescent rebellion or resistance to rules.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{反抗|はんこう}する (to rebel, to resist)
・〜に{反抗|はんこう}する (to rebel against ~)
・{反抗|はんこう}{的|てき} (rebellious, defiant)
・{反抗|はんこう}{心|しん} (rebellious spirit)

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
・{反抗|はんこう}{期|き} (rebellious phase/period - esp. adolescence)
・{反抗|はんこう}{心|しん} (spirit of rebellion)
・{反抗|はんこう}{的|てき}な{態度|たいど} (defiant attitude)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{抵抗|ていこう} - resistance (physical or metaphorical)
・{反対|はんたい} - opposition (to an idea/plan)
・{反発|はんぱつ} - opposition, backlash
